milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The potted_brown_mushroom is at spawn-relative (6, 1, 6) on top of a fence post pedestal in the center of the open pavilion. max_distance=16 allows the player to satisfy this from anywhere in the scene as long as they face the mushroom, which models 'player can see the target.' facing_tolerance=60 ensures intentional observation rather than accidental satisfaction. The player spawns at (0,0,0) facing default direction, which is unlikely to be within 60° of the mushroom's bearing (~45° SE), so this is not auto-satisfied.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block') because this is a build/place task. A Minecraft table is conventionally fence posts as legs with slabs on top. Two rules check for both components: (1) oak_fence with min_count=2 because the scene already contains 1 pre-existing oak_fence at (6,0,6) as the mushroom pedestal — requiring 2 ensures at least 1 player-placed fence leg; (2) oak_slab with min_count=1 since no slabs exist initially — any player-placed slab confirms a tabletop. The generous box [0,0,0] to [12,3,12] covers the entire playable scene area. Known limitation: rules don't enforce spatial relationship between fence and slab, but this is acceptable given available rule types.
